newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Baycorp says profit ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: Baycorp says profit ahead of last year.

text.p: Baycorp Holdings Ltd Chairman Jim Boult said on Tuesday the group's profitability in the year to date was comfortably ahead of the same time last year.

Boult told the annual meeting that Baycorp's lack of debt and strong cashflow would enable the company to continue to pay a high level of its profit back to shareholders in the form of fully-imputed dividends.
"As a result, shareholders may comfortably look forward to another year of increased returns, both in dividends paid and growth of investment value," he said.

"It is therefore pleasing to report that this part of our business has traded in line with budget for the first three months of the current year and is substantially ahead of the same period last year," he said.

Likewise, the second major part of the business, Bay Collection Agency and Creditcorp, had traded strongly in the quarter and again produced results well ahead of the same period last year and in line with budget.
